section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants and procedure for a single study. A total of 238 college women (n=160) and men (n=78), aged 18-35 (M=20.87), were recruited from introductory psychology classes at a large Midwestern university and a community college. The majority of participants (91.6%) identified as Caucasian, and data collection involved participants completing measures in a classroom or after class, suggesting a paper-and-pencil method.
